correctness.rationale: At equilibrium the interior balances force equal sine flows on all path links. Branches with a flipped path cosine have explicit negative directions of the quotient Hessian, so cannot be strictly stable. The all-cohesive angle t has scalar flow (1+3a)s-4as^3 (s=sin t), with strict stability precisely 1+3a-12as^2>0. Maximizing on s in (0,1) gives sup=1-a for a<=1/9, and (1+3a)^(3/2)/(3 sqrt(3a)) beyond; reciprocal yields exact Kc, stable states approach but do not require inclusion at marginal endpoint. Independently symbolically differentiated log Kc=(1-6a)/(2a(1+3a)), located maximum a=1/6 and numerical larger crossing a=0.40889386563522584. The supplied verifier is a finite diagnostic rather than universal proof.
